title: The Alibi of Bellwether Lane
author: J. M. Amberdale
blurb: Yara Ashgrove, the archivist of a cathedral with a locked crypt, thought they had seen every way a life can end. Then twin letters arrive: one confessing, one promising more — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must trap a killer who knows the case file better than the investigators do, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
